name: Air Fryer Beef and Vegetable Skewers with Pita and Tzatziki

components.name: Beef & Vegetable Skewers

ingredients.name: Raw sirloin steak cut into 2.5 cm cubes

steps: Cut steak, peppers and red onion into evenly sized pieces; pat steak dry.
Combine olive oil, shawarma spice blend, salt and black pepper. Toss steak and vegetables to coat, then thread onto short skewers that fit inside the air fryer.
Preheat air fryer to 200 C. Cook skewers in one layer in batches, turning once, approximately 8-12 minutes depending on steak cube size and desired doneness. Use a thermometer to check meat.
Chill leftovers promptly. Freeze cooked skewers only if necessary; yogurt sauce and fresh vegetables lose their texture after freezing.

components.name: Pita Bread

ingredients.name: Four pita breads at 80 g each

steps: Briefly warm the four pita breads. Split the skewers and bread evenly across four meals; pack tzatziki separately.

components.name: Tzatziki

ingredients.name: Raw cucumber, grated and squeezed dry

steps: Grate cucumber, squeeze out excess liquid and mix it with Greek yogurt, crushed garlic, lemon and dill or mint. Chill the tzatziki until serving.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Measured full-meal expansion of the SharkNinja original single-serving beef and vegetable air-fryer skewers.
Planning: Must choose skewers approved for the air fryer and short enough for the basket; batches extend time.
Freezer: cooked beef skewers can freeze; cucumber tzatziki should not be frozen
Dietary: Wheat in pita and milk in Greek yogurt. No pork.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
